description: The file defines FirebaseRepository, which provides real-time data streams for match data from Firebase Realtime Database and maps DataSnapshot objects into app-specific models like Match, Score, Team, and Highlight. It uses Kotlin coroutines' callbackFlow for asynchronous data handling.

classes.name: FirebaseRepository
classes.description: Repository providing real-time match data streams from Firebase Realtime Database, mapping raw DataSnapshot data into strongly-typed models for app use.

methods.name: observeMatches
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits a list of Match objects representing all matches and updates in real-time.

methods.name: observeMatch
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits updates for a particular match specified by matchId, or null if not found or error occurs.

methods.name: parseMatch
methods.description: Converts a Firebase DataSnapshot node into a strongly-typed Match object, extracting various nested fields and handling optional highlight info.
